description: Threads-as-ranks runtime: spawn N rank threads, each running a user closure with its Communicator; per-rank mailboxes (Arc<RwLock>/lock-free MPSC-like queues keyed by (src,tag)) for message passing. MPICH device/ADI analogue, shared-memory only. Android-clean.
